mechanism: Measured from tests/unit/test_stream_path_full_frame_compare.sh with FULL_FRAME_BITSTREAM=tests/fixtures/p3_inter_pred/plex_inter_p16_baseline_624x480_12f.264. Per-stage cycle accounting via stub_busy/fs_wr_reset/fs_swap phase transitions in the Verilator testbench. The aggregate 259 cycles/MB is dominated by decode_stub diagnostic paint (WxH pixels/frame at 1 pixel/cycle) which is NOT a production cost. Production-relevant measured stages are parse_cavlc (~3-4 cycles/MB) and dequant_idct/intra_pred (0 cycles — combinational). MC/deblock/DDR write are NOT IMPLEMENTED and will add significant cost.

target.clock_source: fpga/Plex_MiSTer/rtl/pll/pll_0002.v outclk_0 = 20.000000 MHz; fpga/Plex_MiSTer/Plex.sv connects stream_path.clk(clk_sys)

budget_allocation.status: MIXED — deblock EXTRAPOLATED from w-deblock measurement; MC/ddr_write ESTIMATED; parse/dequant/intra ESTIMATED from measured stubs. Clock constraint (20 MHz) confirmed imaginary by w-arch (ab073d7) — budget may widen to 1368+ cycles/MB pending PLL change.
budget_allocation.clock_note: 20 MHz is the Template_MiSTer default, never chosen (confirmed independently by w-c1 at 547d5e4 and w-arch at ab073d7). Decode can be clock-separated from video via a 4th PLL output. At 40 MHz budget becomes 1368 cycles/MB. Ratchet retains 20 MHz until PLL is actually changed.

parse_cavlc_full.label: ESTIMATED
parse_cavlc_full.reasoning: MEASURED value is 3.2 cycles/MB but for a stub (decode_stub WAIT_MAX timeout on P-frames). IDR-only is 0.245. Production full-MB CAVLC (24 blocks, serial coefficient decode) is unmeasured. 50 is an engineering estimate for worst-case content.

dequant_idct.label: ESTIMATED
dequant_idct.reasoning: MEASURED value is 0 (combinational today). Production must clock through 24 blocks/MB. 2 cycles/block in a 2-stage pipeline = 48.

intra_pred.label: ALLOWANCE
intra_pred.reasoning: MEASURED value is 0 (DC pred=128 only). Allowance for directional modes and mixed I-frame content. All-Plane I-frames spike to ~70.

mc_interpolation.label: ESTIMATED
mc_interpolation.reasoning: Unbuilt module. Assumes 64-bit coalesced DDR, P_L0_16x16, no adjacent-MB overlap, no 4-wide FIR. At >=40 MHz decode clock, adjacent-MB overlap becomes nice-to-have rather than mandatory.

deblock.label: EXTRAPOLATED from w-deblock measurement
deblock.reasoning: REVISED DOWN from 150 to 100. w-deblock measured 56 cycles for 24 internal luma segments (2 cycles/segment via register-file gather/scatter, no SRAM port conflicts). Extrapolated: 48 total segments × 2 cycles = 96, rounded to 100 for boundary edge variation. The register-file architecture eliminates the SRAM bottleneck that drove the 150 estimate. Source: feat/deblock branch.

ddr_write.label: ESTIMATED
ddr_write.reasoning: 48 coalesced 64-bit beats + arbitration turnaround. Not measured.

control_overhead.label: ALLOWANCE
control_overhead.reasoning: Pipeline stalls, MB-boundary bookkeeping, arbitration bubbles. Placeholder.

budget_allocation.verdict: FEASIBLE at 20 MHz with 1.23x margin (recovered 50 cycles from deblock revision). MC breaking point is 376 cycles/MB. However, the 20 MHz constraint itself is confirmed imaginary — at 40 MHz the margin widens to 2.45x and architectural optimisations become optional rather than mandatory. DO NOT optimise MC for overlap exploitation until the clock is settled.

stage_coverage.name: parse_cavlc
stage_coverage.note: Annex-B parse, SPS/PPS/slice header, CAVLC residual decode. Measured as stub_busy rise to fs_wr_reset per VCL frame. Populated from sim stage_cycles. Budget allocation: 50 cycles/MB.

stage_coverage.name: dequant_idct
stage_coverage.note: Zero clock cycles today (combinational). Budget allocation: 48 cycles/MB when processing all 24 blocks per MB in a clocked pipeline.

stage_coverage.name: intra_pred
stage_coverage.note: Zero additional clock cycles today (DC pred=128 only). Budget allocation: 30 cycles/MB for directional modes + Intra_16x16 Plane.

stage_coverage.name: diagnostic_paint
stage_coverage.note: NOT PRODUCTION. decode_stub paints WxH diagnostic pixels per frame at 1 pixel/cycle. Populated from sim stage_cycles.

stage_coverage.name: mc_interpolation
stage_coverage.note: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Budget allocation: 250 cycles/MB (no adjacent-MB overlap). Includes DDR reference fetch (~100 beats with arbitration) and qpel 6-tap interpolation compute. This is the single largest stage and the primary schedule risk.

stage_coverage.name: deblock
stage_coverage.note: NOT IMPLEMENTED in pipeline. Budget allocation: 100 cycles/MB (EXTRAPOLATED from w-deblock measurement: 56 cycles for 24 internal luma segments at 2 cycles/segment via register-file gather/scatter). Full 48-segment extrapolation: ~96 cycles.

stage_coverage.name: ddr_write
stage_coverage.note: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Budget allocation: 50 cycles/MB for 48 coalesced 64-bit beats plus arbitration overhead.

stage_coverage.name: injection_overhead
stage_coverage.note: TESTBENCH ARTIFACT. ioctl byte-by-byte injection at 2 cycles/byte. Real hardware uses DDR DMA.
